triples.subject: TrafficOscillation
triples.context: Based on the analytical wave function derived, we can analyze various properties of the traffic oscillations, the most important is hysteresis.

triples.subject: DynamicalSystem
triples.context: From the phase plot in Fig. 1, we observe that the output of the dynamical system exhibits a phase lag relative to the input.

triples.subject: PhaseLag
triples.context: When transforming the wave function from the complex frequency domain to the time domain, the phase lag leads to a systematic TD.

triples.subject: InputWaveFunction
triples.context: We have defined a input wave function ξ j(t) = A sin(ωt) representing the position perturbation of leader unit j.

triples.subject: PositionPerturbation
triples.context: We have defined a input wave function ξ j(t) = A sin(ωt) representing the position perturbation of leader unit j.

triples.subject: SteadyStateResponse
triples.context: The resulting steady state response of follower unit i is ξ i(t) = A·M·sin (ωt+ϕ).

triples.subject: SpeedOscillation
triples.context: From this, it can be derived that the speed oscillation ˙ξj of the leader unit j is ˙ξj(t) = Aω cos(ωt).

triples.subject: TimeDelay
triples.context: In this analysis, the TD between relative distance d ji(t) and follower speed v i(t) is crucial, as it captures the flip of hysteresis in the (ξ ji,˙ξi) plane, which will be discussed in the following section.

triples.subject: HysteresisLoop
triples.context: By extending the wave functions to the complex plane, it becomes evident that the hysteresis loop originates from the synthesis of two orthogonal waves with different phases.

triples.subject: CompositeWave
triples.context: Since these waves share an identical frequency, the resulting composite wave forms an elliptical shape in the phase plane.

triples.subject: HysteresisEvolutionDirection
triples.context: In this condition, the evolution direction of the hysteresis is uniquely determined by the phase lag: when ϕ ∆<0, the hysteresis trajectory evolves clockwise; when ϕ ∆= 0, the hysteresis degenerates into a straight line passing through the origin; and when ϕ ∆>0, the trajectory evolves counterclockwise.

triples.subject: Hysteresis
triples.context: when ϕ ∆= 0, the hysteresis degenerates into a straight line passing through the origin
